_how_to: Site-wide settings. Edit the text between the quotes. 'tagline' and 'subline' are the big lines on the home page. 'watch_tagline' opens the Watches page. 'description' is what Google and link previews show for the home page. 'on_desk' is the 'On the desk now' row on the home page: folder names of any watches, toys or gear, in order. 'journal_title' heads the journal box on the home page. 'sections' holds the intro line for the Toys and Gear pages. Leave youtube empty to hide YouTube links. 'redirects' sends an old address to a new one, for example after renaming a folder. A photo saved as brand/hero.jpg becomes the big home page photo (with hero_caption under it) and the site's default share image; without one, the featured watch is shown.
